question: In February 2023, who was appointed as the Governor of Bihar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar was appointed as the Governor of Bihar in February 2023.
 
• He succeeded Phagu Chauhan, who was the previous Governor of Bihar.
 
• Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar is a prominent political figure associated with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• Before his appointment as the Governor of Bihar, he served as the Governor of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• Arlekar has also held various significant positions in the state of Goa, including that of the Speaker of the Goa Legislative Assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Governorship in India**

 
 
• The Governor of a state is appointed by the President of India for a term of five years.
 
• The Governor acts as the nominal head while the real power lies with the Chief Minister and the state cabinet.
 
• Governors have the power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissions of punishment or to suspend, remit or commute the sentence of any person convicted of any offense against any law.
 
• They also play a crucial role during state emergencies and have the power to dissolve the state legislative assembly.
 
 
 
• **Role of a Governor**
 
 
• The Governor's primary responsibility is to ensure that the state government acts within the framework of the Constitution.
 
• They appoint the Chief Minister and other members of the Council of Ministers.
 
• Governors have the power to summon or prorogue the state legislature and dissolve the legislative assembly.
 
• They also oversee the administration of the oath of office to the Chief Minister and other ministers.
 
 
 
• **Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar's Background**
 
 
• Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar was born on 23 April 1954 in Goa.
 
• He is an experienced politician with a long-standing association with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• Arlekar has served as a member of the Goa Legislative Assembly and has held various ministerial positions in the state government.
 
• His tenure as Speaker of the Goa Legislative Assembly was marked by significant legislative developments.
 
 
 
• **Recent Governor Appointments**
 
 
• In 2023, several new governors were appointed across various states in India.
 
• Sushri Anusuiya Uikye was appointed as the Governor of Manipur.
 
• Ramesh Bais was appointed as the Governor of Maharashtra.
 
• Gulab Chand Kataria was appointed as the Governor of Assam.
